mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a single month, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.0%), or Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruption (INDPRO below 105.0), a decline in industrial production signals ongoing production bottlenecks that reduce corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO < 105.0 and INDPRO declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may lead to aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%), or Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1250.0 thousand units in a month, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1250.0), or Rank IC over 2-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a monetary policy tightening in the face of high inflation, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where both FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL yoy > 3.0%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
